summary_bullets: Warn when cache cap trim cannot evict pinned or failed versions
Remove dead list_cached_versions helper from upgrade-larch.sh
Add all-pinned cap-overflow regression in test-upgrade-larch-prune.sh
commit_message:
upgrade-larch: warn on cap overflow and drop dead list_cached_versions

Emit a post-loop stderr warning when pinned entries or prune failures leave more than eight cached versions. Remove the unused list_cached_versions helper, document the warning in upgrade-larch.md, and cover the all-pinned overflow path in test-upgrade-larch-prune.sh.
